title: CsvConnector
description: Reads rows from a CSV file (Apache Commons VFS path/URI)

sourceConnectorName.title: Source connector
sourceConnectorName.description: Upstream connector this transform reads from (if applicable)

cacheOnDisk.title: Cache data on disk?
cacheOnDisk.description: Store connector output as Hop binary rows under the server data path. Reloads only when the connector changes or a full presentation refresh is requested.

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: Apache Commons VFS filename or URI (e.g. file:///data/sales.csv)

headerPresent.title: Header present
headerPresent.description: When checked, the first non-empty line is treated as column names

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Locale for decimal and grouping symbols when parsing numbers (and default date parsing). Empty uses the JVM default locale.

groupingSymbol.title: Grouping symbol override
groupingSymbol.description: Optional override for thousands grouping (leave empty to use the Locale). Example: '.' or ','

encoding.title: Encoding
encoding.description: Character encoding of the CSV file

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Max data rows to read (0 = unlimited). Does not include the header line.

detectCsvLayout.title: Detect layout from file
detectCsvLayout.description: Read the header (if present) and first 100 data rows to fill column names and types

fields.title: Columns
fields.description: Output column names, Hop types, format mask, length and precision
